_comment: Test payload for POST /api/research/run. This endpoint is multipart/form-data, not raw JSON: campaign_id/product_brief/brand_kit/audience_brief/market_signal/schema_version/evidence are Form fields (product_brief, brand_kit, audience_brief, market_signal must be sent as JSON-encoded strings), and logo/product_photos/existing_product_visuals are File uploads. The paths below are local filesystem paths to use as the actual uploaded files (e.g. with curl -F or Python requests 'files=').

dont: Do not compare directly to named competitors

curl_example: curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/research/run -F "schema_version=1.0" -F "campaign_id=fizzy-roots-sparkling-tea-launch" -F 'product_brief={"product_name":"Fizzy Roots Sparkling Tea","category":"F&B","key_selling_points":["Zero added sugar","Made in Vietnam","Sparkling, refreshing finish"],"price_or_promotion":{"price":25000,"currency":"VND","promotion":"Buy 4 Get 1 Free"},"target_market":"Vietnam","required_claims":["zero added sugar","made in Vietnam"],"restricted_or_forbidden_claims":["cures bloating","cures illness","guaranteed weight loss"]}' -F 'brand_kit={"brand_colors":{"primary":"#0E7C61","secondary":"#F4D35E","accent":["#FFFFFF"],"palette":["#0E7C61","#F4D35E","#FFFFFF"]},"tone_of_voice":{"description":"playful","attributes":["playful","energetic","youthful"],"do":["Use short punchy sentences"],"dont":["Do not make medical claims"]}}' -F 'audience_brief={"target_customer":"Gen Z","language":"vi","platform":"TikTok Shop","market":"VN"}' -F 'market_signal={"trend":"functional beverages","seasonal_moment":null,"consumer_pain_point":"sugar guilt","search_keyword":["tra hoa qua khong duong"],"competitor_angle":null,"campaign_objective":"Drive trial purchases"}' -F "logo=@C:\Users\ADMIN\Desktop\Hackathon\Tho_Cot\sample_data\05_trung_nguyen_g7\assets\logo.png" -F "product_photos=@C:\Users\ADMIN\Desktop\Hackathon\Tho_Cot\sample_data\05_trung_nguyen_g7\assets\product_01.jpg" -F "product_photos=@C:\Users\ADMIN\Desktop\Hackathon\Tho_Cot\sample_data\05_trung_nguyen_g7\assets\product_02.jpg"
